evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp, src/consensus/consensus.h, and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Implements BIP 54 (Consensus Cleanup) soft fork validation rules on regtest to address legacy consensus DoS and vulnerability risks, including quadratic legacy sigops, CVE-2017-12842 Merkle tree collisions, and timewarp attacks. While inactive on mainnet, bringing the consensus validation engine into Bitcoin Core is strategically important to enable testing and evaluation ahead of any future soft fork activation.
